caveats: Transport-only screening: no capital, operating, permitting, technology, landbase, procurement or facility-design claim.
The class split is a proportional screening allocation of node harvest using v5.1 province/class feedstock shares; it is not a mass-balance routing of harvest residue.
The class module is class-specific but has unlimited throughput in the screen; no class-specific capacity is invented.
The k-series is a greedy heuristic per class, not a globally optimal siting solution; no optimality-gap claim is made.
Distances are haversine x province-factor screening distances, not observed routes for every node-module pair; no full OSRM routing.
Transport cost excludes feedstock, processing, conversion, handling, storage and product revenue.
The k-series has no local-preference penalty, so cross-border flows are unpenalised and are reported, not restricted.
Existing capacity v3 and the 1.2x provincial floor are held fixed; the existing facility set is partitioned by class.
NT positive nodes are demand nodes but not module hosts because no NT road factor is published.
Generic siting is class-agnostic with shared modules; class results are not directly comparable except at k=0 and at exact total-module-count matches.
No national claim, policy claim, UI change or official OSeCAN change is made.
This artifact is not investment advice.

method.candidate_basis: positive class feedstock supply nodes in provinces with a published road factor
method.capacity_basis: national_facility_capacity_v3 with the documented 1.2x provincial floor, partitioned by class and held fixed
method.class_share_source: national_product_chain_v5 product_chain_by_province.csv (v5.1 E1/E2c class feedstock layer)
method.class_split_basis: province class feedstock divided by the province five-class feedstock total, applied to each node harvest weight
method.distance_method: haversine x destination province road factor from facility_road_distance_audit_v2; candidate module uses its node province factor; no full OSRM routing
method.engine: greedy k-median/facility-location screening per class with exact capacitated transport LP re-evaluation (HiGHS)
method.generic_comparison_basis: same per-class k versus generic shared-module k, and class total module count matched to generic k where available (k<=20)
method.heuristic: greedy forward selection per class; at each k the shortlist is the top 10 candidates by capacity-relaxed distance savings; every trial and every k is re-evaluated with the exact capacitated transport LP
method.module_basis: class-specific module at a positive class feedstock supply node; unlimited throughput in the screen; no class capacity, technology, cost, product or residue asserted
method.objective: minimise 2026 CAD truck transport cost from transport_cost_v1 base curve (52.5 m3 payload, empty return); no local-preference penalty
method.optimality: heuristic screening result per class; not a proven global optimum; no optimality-gap claim

scope: 119 Mm3 class-specific transport-only greenfield siting screen over five facility classes
